mentions.name: ECG Interpretation Automation Tool
mentions.description: This tool automates part of ECG interpretation for medical work, aiming to free up doctors' working time and, if it works well, help save lives.
mentions.problem: ECG interpretation takes up part of a doctor's working time that the author wants to automate.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on a tool that can automate part of my work. If it works well it can free doctor working time and save lives too. It's related to ECG interpretation.
mentions.author: AndreiAntoce
